text:
There are no words to describe this kind of pain.

On Friday night, my Innie Minnie, my beautiful baby, unexpectedly crossed the Rainbow Bridge. One moment she was my happy, sassy girl, and within minutes everything changed. Life can change that fast.

No matter how much we love them, no matter how much we do to keep them healthy, no matter how many specialists, emergency doctors, prayers, or sleepless nights... sometimes it is simply out of our hands. We were willing to do anything to save you, but your time was your time. Just like everything else in your life, you chose your own way.

My alpha girl. My sleeping beauty. My lengüita de mamá. You left doing what you loved most, sleeping. Even in your final moments, you were snoring, and somehow you still made me laugh through my tears.

Words will never be able to explain the pain or the emptiness you have left behind. Tiny will miss her partner in crime, and Leila will miss her sassy little sister. As for me... I am missing part of my world, part of my heart. I always knew this day would come someday, but I never imagined it would be this soon.

The house feels quieter. Thank you for every cuddle, every laugh, every stubborn moment, and for loving me through some of the hardest times of my life. You taught me what unconditional love truly means.

Grief has been one of the hardest things I've ever had to navigate. 

You will always be my baby. Always my Minnie girl.

Run free, my beautiful angel. Until we meet again. 🤍🐾
